back: HTTP: request and response for web pages (port 80). HTTPS: HTTP over TLS, encrypted (port 443).
File Transfer Protocol: uploads and downloads files between a client and a server (port 21).
Sends email from a client to a server and between mail servers (port 25).
Downloads email from the server to one device, normally deleting it from the server (port 110).
Manages email on the server so that several devices see the same mailbox (port 143).
A file is split into pieces; a tracker finds peers; peers in a swarm share pieces; seeders have the complete file, leechers are still downloading.
Fast with many peers and spreads the load; speed depends on seeders, risk of malware, can be misused to share copyright files.
Client to server by SMTP; server to server by SMTP; recipient collects with POP3 or IMAP.
